title: Bounded UML intent: story and renderer contracts - not full UML conformance
summary: A source-grounded class, interface, and type view of the current Topocode story document and renderer boundary. It intentionally shows only selected declared extends and type-dependency relationships.

sections.title: «type» DiagramFamily
sections.body: Declares the supported native diagram-family string union selected by a story document.

sections.title: «class» StoryDocumentError
sections.body: Directly extends Error and retains the document path, optional anchor identifier, and explicit failure code.

sections.title: «class» Error (built-in)
sections.body: The built-in base class named by StoryDocumentError's explicit extends clause; it is shown only as that declared inheritance target.

sections.title: «interface» StoryDocument
sections.body: Defines renderer-independent authored story data and declares DiagramFamily as the optional diagram-family type.

sections.title: «interface» ResolvedStoryDocument
sections.body: Carries a StoryDocument together with resolved ResolvedSourceAnchor evidence and repository source identity.

sections.title: «interface» StoryRenderer
sections.body: Declares rendering from a ResolvedStoryDocument to a StoryArtifact, synchronously or through a promise.

sections.title: «interface» StoryArtifact
sections.body: Describes the HTML artifact and pinned renderer identity returned across the renderer boundary.

sections.title: «interface» ResolvedSourceAnchor
sections.body: Directly extends SourceAnchor with the resolved source location and excerpt.

sections.title: «interface» SourceAnchor
sections.body: Declares the stable identifier, repository-relative path, and optional symbol or pattern used to ground authored story evidence.

sections.title: Legend «class» «interface» «type»
sections.body: Markers identify declaration kinds. Edges mean only extends or selected declared type dependency; no composition, aggregation, multiplicity, runtime calls, exhaustive associations, visibility, or generics semantics are asserted.
